Officer's narrative
Officer narrative: Rear-end collision, League City, Texas. Driver 1 reported stopping in slow traffic when the rear of
the vehicle was struck by Driver 2's vehicle. A Passenger was also in Driver 1's vehicle, and my observation at the
scene and both drivers' statements confirm Driver 1 was present in the vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 1 is the
named insured on the policy for the struck vehicle. Driver 1 complained of neck and back strain at the scene. The
force of the impact and the vehicle's rear-end deformation are consistent with the injuries described. Scene
photographs show damage that largely matches the reported impact point and direction. No prior damage to the
vehicle was known to either party or observed during inspection. No independent witnesses were identified, and the
account relies on the drivers' statements and the physical evidence at the scene. Driver 2 acknowledged following too
closely. Both drivers were advised of reporting requirements, and the vehicles were moved from the travel lane
without further incident.
</page>
